verdict.rationale: Docs show the full chain. A workspace can be created directly from a GitHub or Linear issue (docs-12) and gets its own branch, files, terminal and diff (docs-2, docs-29). Agents such as Claude Code or Codex do the work, and Conductor then helps review the diff, open a pull request, merge and archive (docs-21), with PR comments and failing-check logs surfaced in the workspace (docs-11). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue-to-PR flow, and a single documented walkthrough (the chain is assembled from separate doc statements, with no detail on how issue context is passed to the agent or how PR descriptions are generated).
